cohort: 1297 healthy term and late preterm Mongolian neonates (gestational age >=35 weeks, birth weight >=2000 g)
finding: Transcutaneous bilirubin (TcB) levels in Mongolian neonates increased most rapidly in the first 24 hours, less rapidly from 24 to 78 hours, and reached a plateau after 78 hours for the 50th percentile.
